axes.label: What it paid for
axes.description: The purpose the money served, using a shared category vocabulary.

axes.label: Who spent it
axes.description: The ministry or department that spent the money.

axes.label: Where it went
axes.description: The parts a published total breaks into, where a document names them.

axes.label: Which state received it
axes.description: The states that received the money, where the split is published and reconciles.

axes.label: Shared with states or not
axes.description: Whether tax collected enters the divisible pool states take a share of.

axes.label: Revenue or capital
axes.description: Whether spending creates an asset. The same money, classified — not a destination.
